content.comment_body: Modifying 'NET *' variables through the web server is not possible; only 'M*' variables can be changed.
Here is the program. It is not possible to add a BOOL variable of type 'V0.2'.

You can manipulate NetI and NetAI operands with the web server if you know the correct approach. It depends on their settings. If they are configured to read from local variable memory, NetI and NetAI cannot be modified and you must use the VM memory instead (see attached screen video 'VM memory test'). If set to read from a remote device, NetI and NetAI are modifiable (see attached screen video 'NetI and NetAI test'). Videos are provided for reference.
Why are you quoting me in Spanish?

analysis.insight_summary: Users first believe that 'NET *' variables are uneditable via the web server, unlike 'M*' variables. Further clarification shows that modification depends on how these variables are parameterized: those set to read from local memory are not editable via the web server, but variables set to read from a remote device can be changed. There is initial uncertainty about system behavior and configuration effects on web interface capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate modifying 'NET *' variables through the web server, similarly to how they can edit 'M*' variables or basic BOOL variable types.
pain_keywords: lack of clarity for variable states
